title: Why the pipe under your sink is bent

scenes.label: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.text: Why is the pipe under your sink bent? It’s not a mistake.
scenes.voice: Why is the pipe under your sink bent? It's not a mistake.

scenes.text: It’s called a P-trap. Every time you run the tap, a little water stays behind in the bend.
scenes.voice: It's called a P trap. Every time you run the tap, a little water stays behind in the bend.

scenes.text: That water is a seal. It’s the only thing stopping sewer gas from drifting up into your house.
scenes.voice: That water is a seal. It's the only thing stopping sewer gas from drifting up into your house.

scenes.text: But in a drain nobody uses, the water evaporates. The seal is gone. That’s the smell.
scenes.voice: But in a drain nobody uses, the water evaporates. The seal is gone. That's the smell.

scenes.label: THE FIX
scenes.text: The fix is free. Pour in a quart of water. Done.
